# Generated Frontend Artifacts

This directory contains frontend code generated by the `core-cli` from the service definition schema.

**DO NOT MANUALLY EDIT FILES IN THIS DIRECTORY.**
They will be overwritten the next time you run the generator.

## Generation Gap Pattern

This project follows the **Generation Gap** pattern to separate generated code from developer-authored code:

- `generated/`: Contains the scaffolds, types, and hooks produced by the engine. These are refreshed on every run.
- `custom/`: (Parallel to `generated/`) This is where you should write your custom logic, styles, and overrides. The generator will **never** overwrite files in `custom/`.

## How to Re-generate

To refresh these artifacts after updating `schema.yaml`, run:

```bash
core-cli frontend generate --kind both --framework nextjs
```

## Structure

- `lib/api.ts`: Typed fetchers for all service endpoints.
- `types/index.ts`: TypeScript interfaces mirroring the backend entities.
